meta.authoring_receipt: M1.7d: engine structural banks and slots aligned; ring handover gates Mira clue; vault collapse now shares Captain room; bowl pickup wired to inventory use.
meta.notes: Message-only flag: patrol_alert is surfaced by clock.threshold bootstep lines. Other flags are read by a hazard, terminal, or conditional reader. Message-only flag: mira_identified is set by reading Mira’s nameplate and its event line supplies the hook. Content correction: captain_route_known enables the vault collapse shove; the bowl is takeable so Engine.use can reach its reader. Message-only flag: ring_seen marks inspection; only using the carried ring in Mira Gallery sets ring_given.
